comment: src/RGBMatrix.cpp at commit b90cd69; all three sizes are the same template, this one instantiated at 16 by 16. The maker's one-line description in plugin.json calls these an array of lights with built-in oscillators; there are no oscillators in the code. What the X and Y outputs carry is the position of the scan, and its rate comes from the samples-per-pixel knob and the patch's sample rate, so the frame rate is the sample rate divided by the sample count times 256 pixels. The grid of lamps is one widget holding 768 light widgets and no parameters, so no pixel can be clicked for help. In polyphonic mode sixteen pixels are painted per step and the X and Y outputs carry sixteen channels; the grid width must be a multiple of sixteen, which all three sizes are. Double-buffered is on by default and polyphonic mode and fade lights are off.
